text.p: Professionals Insurance Co Management Group said Friday it has agreed to merge its PICOM Insurance Co subsidiary with Physicians Protective Trust Fund, a Coral Gables, Fla.-based provider of medical malpractice insurance for physicians in Florida.
Under terms of the definitive agreement, Professionals Group will issue shares of common stock to eligible members of PPTF in exchange for the assets and liabilities of PPTF.
The number of shares to be issued will range from a minimum of 3,744,897 to a maximum of 4,299,676 based on an average price of Professionals Group common stock prior to the closing.
The deal is expected to close January 1, 1998. As of December 31, 1996, PPTF had a book value of $102 million.

After closing, PICOM will be renamed to reflect the combined insurance operations of PPTF and PICOM. Divisional offices will be maintained in Okemos, Mich. and Coral Gables with local sales and service offices located in Ft. Lauderdale, Orlando, Tampa and Jacksonville, Florida; Oak Brook, Illinois; Indianapolis, Indiana; and, Columbus, Ohio.

"The proposed merger will more than double the size of our organization and better position the company to compete in the medical malpractice insurance market of the future," said Victor Adamo, president of Professionals Group and PICOM.
Together, Professionals Group and PPTF had $800 million in assets and over $190 million in equity at December 31, 1996.

The agreement requires regulatory approvals including the approvals of the Insurance Commissioners of Florida and Michigan, and the approval of eligible members of PPTF and the shareholders of Professionals Group.
